ns2:section.sectionText: Instructor Approval Required, 0 credit hour section. Course is required for students completing an internship within finance field during the fall term. Restricted for MS Finance students. Students must have confirmed an internship in order to take the course. Students on F1 visa must also submit CPT documents to International Student and Scholar Services (ISSS). S/U grading only. Range IV tuition and applicable fees apply.
